2607.12443.title: Language Identification with Succinct Machine-Independent Traces
2607.12443.paper_summary: Motivated by the power of large language models, there has been renewed interest in the Gold-Angluin model of language identification in the limit, with an eye toward variants of the model that might overcome the negative results for its original formulation. Recent papers on this question have proposed looking at computational traces and annotations of training strings as a source of additional power for a learner, reflecting empirical regularities such as the way that commented source code is easier to learn from than arbitrary source code, and text annotated with algorithmically generated chain-of-thought tokens can be easier to learn from than the raw text itself. This recent work has shown positive results for language identification in the presence of such computational traces, but the traces in these positive results come from explicit automata-theoretic machine models that generate the language, where the underlying vocabulary of tokens for the traces is very large. In this paper, we address two fundamental issues left open by this line of work: can we achieve positive results with traces that use only a small alphabet, and can we define traces directly from the language itself, without requiring an underlying machine model that generates it? We establish positive results for both of these questions: for an arbitrary collection of languages, we show how to define computational traces that enable identification in the limit, using an alphabet of tokens that is linear in the size of the alphabet that the languages are defined over, and independent of any other properties of the languages.
2607.12443.paper_summary_zh: 受到大型語言模型的啟發，人們對Gold-Angluin的語言識別極限模型重新產生了興趣，並希望能找到該模型的變體，以克服其原始表述所帶來的負面結果。最近針對這個問題的論文提出，應該將計算痕跡和訓練字串的註解視為學習者的額外力量來源，反映出經驗上的規律，例如帶有註解的源代碼比隨機的源代碼更容易學習，而帶有算法生成的思維鏈標記的文本比原始文本本身更容易學習。這項最新研究顯示，在存在這些計算痕跡的情況下，語言識別取得了正面結果，但這些正面結果中的痕跡來自於明確的自動機理論機器模型，這些模型生成了語言，而痕跡的基礎標記詞彙非常龐大。在本文中，我們探討了這項研究所留下的兩個基本問題：我們能否僅使用小字母表的痕跡來獲得正面結果，以及我們能否直接從語言本身定義痕跡，而不需要生成它的底層機器模型？我們對這兩個問題都建立了正面結果：對於任意的語言集合，我們展示了如何定義計算痕跡，使其能夠在極限中識別，使用的標記字母表大小與語言定義的字母表大小成線性關係，並且與語言的其他屬性無關。
